Clear Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our interior architecture, modular systems, and turnkey delivery in Bengaluru.

What is included in complete home interiors?
Complete home interiors can include living room design, bedroom interiors, modular kitchen, wardrobes, TV units, storage, false ceiling, lighting, electrical work, painting, flooring, civil modifications and installation. The package can be customised based on the homeowner's lifestyle, requirements and budget.
What is the difference between turnkey interiors and modular interiors?
Modular interiors generally focus on factory-made furniture such as kitchens and wardrobes, while turnkey interiors can cover the entire project, including design, civil work, electrical, plumbing, false ceiling, painting, furniture and installation. Turnkey interiors are therefore suitable for homeowners seeking a complete solution.
How much does a 2BHK interior cost in Bangalore?
The cost of 2BHK interiors in Bangalore depends on the size of the apartment, materials, modular kitchen, wardrobes, ceiling, electrical work, civil modifications and level of customisation. A professional interior company can provide a project-specific quotation after understanding the home's requirements.
What materials are best for modular kitchens?
The right modular kitchen materials depend on durability, moisture resistance, budget and usage. Options can include different grades of plywood, engineered boards, laminates, acrylic finishes and other surface materials. A professional modular kitchen designer can recommend suitable combinations for the specific kitchen.
How much do home interiors cost in Bangalore?
The cost of home interiors in Bangalore varies depending on the apartment size, materials, design requirements, modular furniture, civil work and level of customisation. A professional interior company can prepare a project-specific quotation after understanding your requirements.
How can I plan home interiors on a budget?
Start by prioritising essential areas such as the modular kitchen, wardrobes, storage and lighting, then allocate the remaining budget to decorative elements and custom furniture. Choosing practical materials and finalising the design before execution can also help control home interior costs.
How long does a typical project take?
A single room can take 4–6 weeks from approval to handover; a full home typically runs 4–8 months depending on structural work. You'll receive a stage-by-stage timeline during the design and planning phase.
What happens during the first consultation?
We walk the space (or review your floor plans), discuss how you use the area day to day, and align on style, budget, and timeline. It's a working conversation, not a sales pitch — and it's free.
